# SafeDesk Kft. — Monitoring service order

SafeDesk Kft. supplies alert monitoring for Project Atlas and Project Beacon Lab. The agreement renews on 2027-05-31. IT owns the production alert routing, while Finance approves the sandbox contact list. The supplier keeps the two service queues separate so that a training exercise does not page the production duty engineer.

The service order includes alarm receipt, contact attempts and a monthly summary of unattended alerts. A contact attempt is recorded even when the nominated person cannot be reached. The service owner decides which events require a telephone call. A repeated warning can be grouped into an ongoing incident only when the original event identifier is retained.

Finance has requested that sample-file exercises use the sandbox queue during booked training periods. Alerts from those exercises remain visible to the trainer until the session ends. They do not contribute to the production availability report. The duty team can temporarily silence a known test event after a reviewer approves the reason and the end time.

For planned maintenance, the service owner supplies the start time, the expected symptoms and a restoration contact. The supplier returns an acknowledgement before the maintenance window opens. An acknowledgement confirms that the instruction was received; it does not prove that the underlying service has recovered. The technical owner closes an incident after checking its actual behaviour.

The monthly contact-list review will remove obsolete telephone numbers and confirm substitute staff for holidays. Procurement has requested that invoice adjustments distinguish training support from production escalation work. Additional overnight coverage is not included in the current order. Any change must identify the affected service queue and the date the new coverage begins.
